measurement.gpu_seconds: CUPTI interval union; node-level graph tracing required; profiled walls include profiler overhead
measurement.memory_claim: Only GPU-native holds the pinned physical guard throughout the service, enforcing <=28e9 physical bytes per GPU. Both arms use auto arenas. This is an enforced ceiling, not an observed exact peak.
measurement.baseline_memory_scope: Original auto arena without physical canary; no28GBclaim forbaseline.
measurement.quiet_scope: Five one-second idle samples with pod cgroup PSI some/full <=0.5% of measured idle duration; zero throttling during idle and inventory; steal<=1%; no foreign GPU or owned compiler. Background memory sampling paused during admission and resumed before request. Inventory-probe PSI recorded separately; host load informational. Previous zero-PSI and 0.1% admission failures are retained.

instrumentation.headline: unprofiled; independentfullcapture diagnosticSHA256OFFbotharms; R1flagsOFFbotharms (noR1privateCaptureSeal pathselected)
instrumentation.ownership_profile_pair: Nsight node trace; independentfullcaptureSHA OFF botharms; excludedheadline medians
instrumentation.correctness: Use rv64_gate.sh for bounded cold/warm correctness; the canonical runner accepts strict quiet six-service comparisons only.

measurement.pending_authority_floor: One recursion lane per physical device; two logical lanes use the default pending-authority floor 17.
measurement.timed_scope: The default environment versus GPU-native jobs with installed reuse and packed ingress. Physical guard applies only to the native candidate. Admission and sibling-session experiments are retired from this preset.
